question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The manager swiftly overtook him, __________ effortlessly past the skinny Englishman, with a practiced ease.
solution:
The correct answer is '**sliding**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**sliding**" means moving smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it.
 
• In the given context, the manager is moving past the skinny Englishman with practiced ease, which suggests a smooth and effortless motion.
 
• The other options: "**kindling**," "**dawdling**," and "**rendering**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The manager swiftly overtook him, sliding__ effortlessly past the skinny Englishman, with a practiced ease.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Kindling (जलाने की लकड़ी)**: means easily combustible small sticks or twigs.
 
• **Dawdling (मीन-मेख निकालना)**: means to waste time or be slow.
 
• **Rendering (व्याख्या करना)**: means to provide or give a service, help, etc.
